services.name: Private Lessons
services.desc: Private vocal coaching and lessons are available with Jake Walters. All levels of experience welcome. Great for all performers-- from a young beginner first learning to sing and read sheet music, to a high school actor preparing for the big musical audition at school, to an aspiring professional singer or actress. If interested, please use contact form below or email troubadourtheatre@yahoo.com Jake serves as music director for both Troubadour Theatre and Gaslight Youth Theatre. Jake has performed in countless musical theatre productions including Stephen Sondheim’s Into The Woods, Charles Strouse’s Bye Bye Birdie, and various roles in Charles Dickens’ A Christmas Carol at The Comedy
